scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-development} AUTOGRAPHY_PREVIEW_ROLE_MODE=${AUTOGRAPHY_PREVIEW_ROLE_MODE:-true} && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=development AUTOGRAPHY_PREVIEW_ROLE_MODE=true node ./test-build.mjs && NODE_ENV=development AUTOGRAPHY_PREVIEW_ROLE_MODE=true node --test --test-concurrency=1 $(find .test-dist -name '*.test.js' -print)
